sources.quote: Kepler-8b is the fifth of the first five exoplanets discovered by NASA's Kepler spacecraft, which aims to discover planets in a region of the sky between the constellations Lyra and Cygnus that transit their host stars.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Kepler-8. Its orbit and size follow Esteves et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
